description:
**Hiring for PULS Group**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1,700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure.

**About the Role**

PULS runs live AI solutions used every day by Purchasing, Finance, Logistics, R&D and Sales: chat agents integrated with SAP, scheduled Azure jobs, document pipelines, workflow apps and dashboards. You will keep them reliable and keep improving them. That means resolving incidents at the root cause, shipping change requests in regular maintenance releases, and keeping everything monitored and documented. You will work from India with core hours overlapping the Munich morning (about 13:00–18:00 IST), with no night shifts and no solo on-call, alongside the AI team, DevOps and Cybersecurity. Onboarding is in Munich, with one or two visits a year after that.

**What you'll do**

* Own the incident and change-request queue for all live AI solutions: reproduce on the test stage, separate bugs from change requests and agree weekly priorities with the AI Team Lead
* Fix root causes across the stack: TypeScript/React frontend, Node.js or Python (FastAPI) backend, scheduled jobs, SAP OData integration, PDF and mailbox automation, and write the test that proves each fix
* Ship enhancements in maintenance releases (new SAP fields, document layouts, extended agent skills) and turn larger requests into specifications for the project team
* Use Claude Code and Codex to draft fixes and tests, then review, verify on the preview stage and merge
* Catch rising error rates, silently failed jobs and token-cost drift with KQL in Log Analytics; release prompt, skill and model updates on Azure OpenAI only after regression cases and an LLM-as-judge review pass
* Run Azure Container Apps and jobs across preview, pilot and production with DevOps: Bicep, rollbacks, Key Vault secrets, Entra app registrations and Teams app updates
* Take over solutions built by business teams and keep runbooks and documentation current

**What you bring**

* 4–6 years of full-stack development on production systems you not only built but kept running
* TypeScript/React and Node.js, plus Python with FastAPI; SQL with PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB
* Azure in daily practice: Container Apps, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Service Bus, Entra ID, Bicep and the Azure CLI
* Has shipped LLM applications to production: tool calling, prompt guardrails, RAG (pgvector) and evaluation
* Real debugging depth, e.g. has traced a 401/403 through an OAuth on-behalf-of chain and an API gateway to its root cause, and reads logs with KQL
* At least 6 months of daily Claude Code or Codex use on production code. Expect live pairing on a real ticket in the interview
* Secrets management, RBAC and GDPR as everyday practice; clear written English (C1) for non-technical colleagues in Jira and docs

**Nice to have**

* SAP OData integration experience
* PowerShell for Windows-based deployment and operations tooling
* Microsoft Teams app development

description:
**Job Description Summary**
GE Vernova delivers reactive power compensators such as Static Synchronous Compensators (STATCOM) and Static Var Compensators (SVC), on which we are the global FACTS Solution Line based in Finland, India, Brazil and US. These systems are used to control power system voltage and reactive power flow as well as to improve the power system stability and transmission system efficiency. Via our projects, you truly have a chance to make the world a better place by helping our global customers in saving vital energy and securing stable electricity distribution.
  
  
The Lead Engineer Control Software is responsible for the technical ownership and delivery of control system functions for complex power system and FACTS projects. In addition to performing hands-on control system design and implementation, the Lead Engineer coordinates technical activities across the project, leads testing and commissioning activities, and acts as a technical mentor for other control software engineers.
  
  
The role requires strong technical expertise combined with the ability to lead technical work packages, coordinate multidisciplinary activities, communicate with customers and stakeholders, and ensure successful delivery of control software solutions from requirements through commissioning.
  
  
The position is based in Noida, India, with hybrid work flexibility. You will be working on cutting edge technology and varied international high-profile projects. In this position, you will be reporting to Engineering Manager – Control Software, Noida office and it can be considered a top priority position to perform in a critical engineering discipline for overall FACTS business.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement STATCOM/SVC control algorithms and control functions using MATLAB/Simulink.
* Perform MATLAB/Simulink implementation, simulation, verification, and validation of control functions.
* Develop and execute PSCAD simulations, particularly for dynamic performance studies and validation of STATCOM/SVC control performance.
* Perform controller performance evaluation under various grid operating conditions, disturbances, faults, voltage variations, and reactive power requirements.
* Develop and maintain simulation models for STATCOM/SVC control and system performance assessment.
* Perform RTDS-based real-time testing of STATCOM/SVC controllers, including closed-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
* Prepare RTDS test cases, test procedures, signal lists, test reports, and analyze test results.
* Support STATCOM/SVC commissioning activities, including controller testing, tuning, functional verification, site troubleshooting, and performance validation.
* Lead software/control engineering activities for STATCOM/SVC projects from engineering through testing and commissioning.
* Coordinate with system studies, primary engineering, protection, SCADA, hardware, and project engineering teams.
* Provide technical leadership for software development, simulation, testing, troubleshooting, and resolution of project-specific control issues.
* Support customer discussions, technical reviews, FAT, site acceptance testing, commissioning, and performance tests.
* Review technical specifications and ensure control system design complies with project and grid-code requirements.
* Investigate and resolve control-system issues identified during simulation, RTDS testing, FAT, commissioning, or site operation.
* Mentor junior engineers and establish good engineering practices for simulation, software development, testing, and documentation.

**Mandatory Technical Requirements**

* MATLAB/Simulink
* Strong hands-on experience in MATLAB/Simulink.
* Experience in implementing and simulating control algorithms and control functions.
* Ability to troubleshoot simulation results and optimize control performance.
* PSCAD
* Strong practical experience with PSCAD/EMTDC.
* Experience in dynamic performance studies of STATCOM/SVC systems.
* Understanding of transient and dynamic behavior of power electronic converters connected to the grid.
* Experience in analyzing faults, voltage disturbances, reactive power response, control interactions, and system stability.
* RTDS Testing
* Hands-on experience in RTDS real-time simulation and controller testing.
* Experience with closed-loop/HIL testing of STATCOM/SVC controllers.
* Knowledge of RTDS signal interfacing, test-case development, controller integration, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to analyze RTDS test results and identify controller/software issues.
* STATCOM/SVC Commissioning
* Practical experience in STATCOM or SVC commissioning.
* Experience in controller functional testing, tuning, signal verification, fault testing, reactive power/voltage control verification, and site troubleshooting.
* Willingness to travel to project sites for commissioning and customer support.
* Software/Control Engineering Leadership
* Proven experience in leading software/control engineering activities for STATCOM/SVC projects.
* Ability to plan and execute software development, simulation, testing, FAT, RTDS testing, and commissioning activities.
* Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering and project teams.
* Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making capability.

**Qualifications / Requirements**

* Minimum 10-15 years of experience in FACTS/HVDC projects

Our telecom products run on networking software built close to the packet: code that handles traffic, protocols and tunnels at carrier scale. Keeping that software reliable means fixing issues quickly and understanding why they happened.
  
  
In this role, you’ll start by learning our products and working on smaller issues alongside senior engineers, helping them diagnose and fix problems. It’s a hands-on way to build real depth in networking software, where the answers come from understanding the code and the protocols.

* Investigate and fix smaller issues in existing C/C++ code, with guidance from senior engineers
* Help senior engineers reproduce, debug and resolve product issues
* Support the product by analysing logs and test results to find the root cause of problems
* Test your changes, and document what you found and how you fixed it
* Take on more complex work as your understanding of the product grows

**What You’ll Bring**
Experience and expertise
  
  

* A degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Telecommunications or a related field
* 2+ years of experience in networking software development
* Solid programming skills in C and/or C++
* Familiarity with networking protocols across layers 2 to 4
* Working knowledge of IPsec and SSL/TLS
* Experience with overlays and tunnelling (e.g. VXLAN, GRE)
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* Good written and spoken English

How you work
  
  

* Curious and keen to learn, and comfortable saying “I don’t know yet”
* You can explain the code you’ve written
* Methodical when debugging: you look for the root cause, not just a quick fix
* Ask for help when you’re stuck, and take feedback on board
* Communicate clearly with colleagues in a distributed team

* Understanding of DPDK
* Experience working in cloud environments

**What You’ll Have The Opportunity To Do**

title: Connectivity Validation Engineer
description:
****Career Area:****
Engineering
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****JOB PURPOSE:****
For Caterpillar, Connectivity means using technology to extract data from our machines and engines and transform it into valuable recommendations and insights to help customers make better, more informed decisions and help Caterpillar make robust products with the lowest total ownership cost. Our products generate and process large amounts of data from sensors, on-board models, and control algorithms in real-time, creating real-world machine usage information to provide condition monitoring and fleet management services.
  
  
****Job Description****
Caterpillar’s
**Connectivity Systems team – Cat Technology Division**
is currently seeking an
**Electronic Systems Verification and Validation Engineer**
to support the End-to-End Connectivity Validation team.
  
  
In this role, you will provide technical leadership in defining and executing
**validation strategies**
for complex connected products across onboard machine/engine systems, embedded software, connectivity, and back-office systems. You will drive
**Shift Left validation**
by expanding the use of simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SiL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL), test automation, and other advanced validation methods to identify issues earlier in the product development lifecycle.
  
  
You will be part of a global engineering team working closely with Systems, Software, Hardware, and Product teams to define validation strategies, develop
**DVP&R**
, conduct release validation, automate testing, troubleshoot complex issues, and continuously advance Caterpillar’s validation capabilities.
  
  
****What You Will Do:****
The primary function of this role is to apply
**engineering principles and technical leadership**
to the verification and validation of embedded and connected systems that enable Caterpillar telematics products.
  
  

* Define validation strategies and own DVP&R based on product requirements, architecture, customer use cases, and technical risks.
* Determine appropriate validation coverage across SIL, HIL bench, system, machine, and End-to-End environments.
* Develop validation plans, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and requirements-to-test traceability.
* Lead system integration and End-to-End validation across embedded hardware/software, connectivity, and back-office interfaces.
* Develop and expand automated regression and continuous validation capabilities to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Analyse test results, troubleshoot complex system issues, and drive root-cause analysis and issue resolution.
* Introduce new validation approaches, simulation capabilities, automation frameworks, and AI-assisted methods to improve quality and productivity.
* Champion Shift Left validation using simulation, SIL, virtual environments, and automation to identify defects earlier in the development cycle.
* Influence product requirements and design to improve testability, diagnosability, reliability, and robustness.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers and communicate validation status, technical risks, and release readiness to stakeholders.

****Education Requirement:****
**What You Have (Basic Requirements):**

* Degree or advanced degree in an accredited Engineering curriculum in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline with 9-12 years related experience.

****Technical Excellence:****

* Strong working knowledge of embedded and connected systems and the ability to provide solutions to complex technical challenges.
* Ability to define validation strategies and provide technical leadership across multiple levels of product validation.
* Ability to mentor engineers and influence technical decisions across cross-functional teams.

****Product Testing:****

* Excellent working knowledge of product testing approaches, techniques, and tools; ability to design, plan, and execute End-to-End system validation.
* Experience developing DVP&R, validation plans, test coverage, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability.
* Experience with SiL, HiL, simulation, system integration, regression, and release validation.
* Ability to evaluate and introduce new test environments, tools, and validation methods.

****Analytical Thinking:****

* Strong knowledge of data analysis and diagnostic techniques to interpret complex test results and system behavior.
* Ability to break down complex system problems, identify potential root causes, and drive technical issues to resolution.
* Ability to use validation evidence and engineering judgement to assess product risk and readiness.
* Applies lessons learned to improve future validation coverage and prevent issue recurrence.

****Effective Communications:****

* Collaborative team player with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Clearly communicates technical information, validation findings, risks, and recommendations across diverse teams.
* Effectively presents and reviews validation strategies, results, and technical issues with process partners and leadership.
* Provides technical guidance, constructive feedback, and coaching to other engineers.

****Top Candidates Will Have:****

* Demonstrated experience defining validation strategies and DVP&R for embedded or connected products.
* Strong experience with embedded systems, system integration, and End-to-End validation.
* Experience with connectivity technologies such as CAN/J1939, Ethernet, Cellular/4G/5G, GNSS, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and MQTT.
* Strong experience with Python scripting and automated test frameworks.
* Experience with dSPACE tools such as VEOS, ControlDesk, AutomationDesk, or equivalent SiL/HiL environments.
* Experience developing or enhancing test benches, simulators, and validation infrastructure.
* Experience with CI/CD or continuous validation practices.
* Practical experience applying AI/GenAI to engineering or validation workflows is an advantage.
* Strong ability to troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and system integration issues.

****Posting Dates:****
November 10, 2026 - November 23, 2026

title: MES Engineer: Pharmaceutical & Biotech Manufacturing
description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.

Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.

Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top-tier global investors, 60+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.

**About The Role**

We're hiring an MES (Manufacturing Execution System) Engineer to help pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers move from paper to digital batch execution.

You'll implement, configure and improve MES solutions for our clients, and every project has to meet strict GMP and data integrity standards. You'll report to a Lead or Senior Engineer, and you'll own work packages as your experience grows.

**What You'll Do**

**Delivery & Implementation**

* Work on MES projects from start to finish: requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, deployment and Hypercare.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and turn them into MES functional and technical requirements, workflows and configurations.
* Configure MES solutions to fit each client's operations, including electronic batch records (EBR), recipes, production workflows and master data.
* Design and deliver integrations with enterprise systems such as ERP (for example SAP), LIMS, WMS and QMS, and with shop-floor (L2) equipment and automation systems.
* Find and fix system issues quickly to keep production downtime low.

**Compliance & Validation**

* Apply GMP, GAMP 5, data integrity (ALCOA+), EU Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 to all MES work.
* Prepare validation deliverables and help execute them, including specifications, IQ/OQ/PQ test scripts and traceability matrices. Follow computerized system validation (CSV) and computer software assurance (CSA) principles.
* Help with deviations, root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of MES implementation or consulting experience in pharmaceutical, biotech or life sciences.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major MES platform, such as Leucine MES, Körber PAS-X, Emerson Syncade, Siemens Opcenter, FactoryTalk PharmaSuite or GE Proficy.
* A solid understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, electronic batch records, recipes and production execution.
* Practical experience with MES configuration, documentation, testing and validation support.
* Knowledge of system integration, including ERP-MES interfaces, L3-L2 integration and APIs.
* The ability to turn requirements into MES documentation, workflows, configurations and test cases
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication, coordination and stakeholder management.
* Comfortable working on your own or as part of a team

**Mandatory**

* Working knowledge of GMP, GAMP 5, data integrity, EU Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11, applied in MES work.
* Hands-on experience with batch processes in pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing.
* Proven experience with MES platforms, electronic batch records, testing and validation.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with digital transformation or Industry 4.0 initiatives.
* Experience with cloud-based or SaaS MES solutions.
* Certification in an MES platform or related technology.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server or Oracle databases.
* Hands-on SAP integration experience, for example PP-PI, MM and QM

**Benefits**

* Be part of a fast-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high-performing team building innovative AI-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
* Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: Engineering Manager - Internal Systems Automations Platform
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Internal Systems Automations Platform team’s mission is to unlock productivity across all of Stripe’s internal systems. We build solutions to transform core processes for Finance, Accounting, People, Legal, Sales, Marketing, and more. We orchestrate the full automation lifecycle, using artificial intelligence (AI) for planning, analysis, and reasoning, and deterministic scripts, code, and pipelines for reliable and trustworthy execution. We enable technical and nontechnical users to build hybrid code and no-code automations while working with central Operations, Developer Productivity, Infrastructure, and machine learning (ML) teams on behalf of all Internal Systems customers to build powerful platforms together.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
We’re looking for an experienced engineering manager with a passion for simplifying complex systems and driving operational efficiency. In this role, you’ll analyze existing processes across Stripe’s internal systems, use automation platforms where possible, and design new solutions when needed. You will implement cutting-edge automation solutions, including AI agents, robotic process automation (RPA), and data pipelines, and build best-in-class platforms. You’ll be responsible for continuously improving workflows to maximize efficiency and deliver meaningful business impact across a broad set of internal stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead your team of talented engineers to design and deploy data pipelines and intelligent workflows that simplify operations for internal customers, including Finance, Accounting, Legal, People, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams.
* Collaborate with product managers and talk directly with users to drive a high-impact, prioritized roadmap for your team.
* Recruit, coach, mentor, develop, and grow engineers on your team.
* Be deeply involved in launching new product features and capabilities.
* Partner with engineers and product managers across Stripe to ensure your features are integrated into the Stripe suite.

Who you are
  
  
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 5+ years of engineering management experience and 10+ years of overall experience in the industry.
* Proven experience working on high-scale systems with a strong technical foundation.
* Works very well cross-functionally and is able to think rigorously and make hard decisions and tradeoffs.
* Thrives on a high level of autonomy and responsibility.
* Encourages a healthy work environment that’s both supportive and challenging and enables engineers to do their best work.
* Strong technical background and hands-on experience in solving large-scale and difficult technical problems.
* Ability to work with diverse internal teams and stakeholders across Finance, Legal, Operations, and other business functions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI, large language model (LLM), or ML technologies is highly valuable.
* Understanding of context-driven AI agents that can autonomously figure out solutions when given business problems and context.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now
